mentions.name: YomuNews
mentions.description: Japanese news learning app with osu-style gamification. News articles are adjusted to the reader's level using LLMs, and users take quizzes and compete on a leaderboard.
mentions.source_excerpt: Japanese news app with osu-like gamification.  You read the news that’s adjusted to your reading level with LLMs, take quizzes, compete on the leaderboard.
